settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure the workspace, features, editing behavior, and theme.

vault.label: Vault
vault.description: Choose the local directory used for filesystem note storage.

assetsFolder.label: Assets
assetsFolder.description: Choose the folder for storing note images and attachments, relative to the vault.

trashRetentionDays.label: Trash retention days
trashRetentionDays.description: Automatically delete trashed notes after this many days.

autosaveDelay.label: Autosave delay (ms)
autosaveDelay.description: Controls how long the editor waits before saving content changes.

editorColors.label: Editor colors
editorColors.description: Preview the configured highlight and block background palette.

accentColor.label: Accent color
accentColor.description: Used for primary highlights across the app.

sidebarBackgroundColor.label: Sidebar background color
sidebarBackgroundColor.description: Used as the background color for the left sidebar panel.

sidebarTextColor.label: Sidebar text color
sidebarTextColor.description: Used for sidebar labels, section titles, and controls.

defaultEditorColor.label: Default editor color
defaultEditorColor.description: Used as the default highlight and background color for supported editor tools.

favorites.label: Favorites
favorites.description: Show the Favorites workspace view and favorite note actions.

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.description: Show the Tasks workspace view for notes with open checklist items.

pinned.label: Pinned notes
pinned.description: Allow notes to be pinned to the top of the current list.

nonDistractionMode.label: Non-distraction mode
nonDistractionMode.description: Allow the note view to enter the focused writing layout.

noteWebhook.label: Note webhook
noteWebhook.description: Allow notes to store and trigger outbound webhook URLs.

showSidebarPanel.label: SidebarPanel
showSidebarPanel.description: Show the left workspace navigation panel by default.

showNotesListPanel.label: NotesListPanel
showNotesListPanel.description: Show the center note list panel by default.

sidebarFolders.title: Folders
sidebarFolders.errorDuplicate: A folder with this name already exists
